title: Gaussian surface area bound for a ball
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $c\in\mathbb R^n$, and let $r>0$. The Gaussian surface area of the closed Euclidean ball of radius $r$ centred at $c$ is at most $\sqrt{2/\pi}$.
